basis: QGSO median sale price of detached dwellings (houses), 12 months ending each quarter, Queensland Valuation and Sales data
name: Brisbane
notes: Brisbane: QGSO's median sale price of detached dwellings in Greater Brisbane, for 12 months ending each quarter, 2000-09 to 2026-06 (quarter of the window's end). Each point is a 12-month median, so consecutive quarters overlap by nine months; figures are preliminary and revised. Medians are of all sales by contract date, not mix-adjusted. Districts: 39 SA3s and 237 SA2s (ASGS 2021), detached dwellings, kept when they have 32+ published quarters (medians on fewer than 10 sales in the 12 months are not published). Attached dwellings and vacant land shown as segments. House sales in the 12 months to the latest quarter: 37877.
